title: fog-risk-state: levodopa OFF-state detection from freeze-free walking with a single lower-back accelerometer
description: Analysis plan, code, results and embedded Cortex-M4F implementation of a study on detecting the levodopa OFF state from freeze-free walking in people with freezing of gait, using a single lower-back accelerometer. The plan, the frozen gait gate and the analysis code were committed before any medication-state result was computed. Post hoc analyses are documented in a dated amendment. Raw data are not redistributed.
